risk_summary: The disclosure presents substantial operating risk from declining oil and gas prices, reduced client spending, lower crew utilization, weather and permitting delays, and pricing pressure. While it provides useful quantitative detail on crew counts, contract mix, debt, and lease obligations, repeated forward-looking disclaimers and conditional language limit visibility into future performance and liquidity.
